The Ayrshire Standard

The look of real wood, made for everyday living

Our laminate ranges capture the grain, texture and warmth of natural timber — with a tough, family-friendly surface that stands up to busy Scottish homes, muddy paws and all.

Every floor is click-fit for straightforward installation, and we stock the underlay, beading and trims to finish the job properly.

  • Realistic wood grain and texture, plank by plank
  • Click-lock fitting — no glue, no fuss
  • Matching accessories for a flawless finish
  • Ordered Friday, delivered the following week

Room Calculator

How much flooring do you need?

Enter your room measurements and we’ll work out the area, add a recommended allowance for cutting and wastage, and tell you exactly how many packs to order.

For L-shaped or irregular rooms, split the space into rectangles and add the areas together — or contact us and we’ll help you work it out.

Delivery Information

Order on Friday. Delivery the following week.

We keep things simple and local. Here is exactly how ordering with Ayrshire Flooring works, from basket to your front door.

01

Place your order online

Browse the range, work out your packs with our calculator, and check out online at any time during the week.

02

We order every Friday

All online orders are submitted to our supplier each Friday, so your flooring is ordered fresh for you.

03

Delivered the following week

Your order is delivered to your home the following week. We’ll be in touch to arrange a delivery day that suits you.

Do we deliver to you?

Delivery is currently available exclusively in Ayrshire and Glasgow. Enter the first part of your postcode to check your area.

All KA postcodesAll G postcodesAyrshire & Glasgow only
